newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London firmer, banks gain.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London firmer, banks gain.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London gained on Tuesday, pushed higher by bank issues and dollar-sensitive blue chips, dealers said.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 rose 10.55 points to 1,647.76 by 1428 GMT. Earlier in Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 fell 159.31 points to close at 20,069.41, hit by profit-taking.

Dealers said bank stocks were boosted by news of a joint venture between Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan (LTCB) and Swiss Bank Corporation to serve Japanese corporate, institutional and wealthier private customers.
Shares in Industrial Bank of Japan advanced 30 yen to 1,690 yen, while Mitsubishi Trust and Banking rose 10 yen to 1,710 yen.
Elsewhere in London, dealers said dollar-sensitive, hi-tech stocks firmed, fuelled by a dollar rally against the yen on the foreign exchanges.
Sony Corporation was the pick of the sector as the shares climbed 200 yen to 10,300 yen.
